tags.description: 1-3 most relevant tags from: Invoice, Receipt, Payment, Refund, Subscription, Bill, Expense Report, Bank Statement, Tax Document, Financial Report, Investment Update, Loan, Insurance, Meeting Request, Meeting Invite, Meeting Notes, Meeting Reschedule, Meeting Cancellation, Calendar Invite, Reminder, RSVP Request, Availability Request, Flight Booking, Hotel Reservation, Travel Itinerary, Boarding Pass, Visa/Immigration, Car Rental, Restaurant Reservation, Event Ticket, Transportation, Order Confirmation, Shipping Update, Delivery Notice, Package Tracking, Return Request, Refund Processed, Wishlist, Cart Reminder, Price Drop Alert, Security Alert, Password Reset, Two-Factor Auth, Login Notification, Account Locked, Verification Code, Privacy Update, Terms Update, Data Breach Notice, Task Assignment... and more. Primary tag first, then secondary if applicable. Be specific.

reasoning.description: Brief analysis (1-2 sentences): tone, content type, red flags if any, why you chose these tags.

summary.description: Clear, direct summary in 1-2 sentences. Strip jargon and fluff.

action_items.description: Concrete actionable tasks starting with a verb. Empty array if no actions needed.

urgency.description: Time-sensitivity: critical=immediate, high=today, normal=this week, low=whenever, none=informational
